chunks: As though it would burst with fury. Every time a crowd is thrown into it, its wardens will ask: 'Did no warner come to you?'
ai.seo_question: What happens to Hellfire when disbelievers are thrown into it according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the personification of Hellfire as 'ready to burst' (tamayyazu) from rage underscores the visceral reality of divine retribution against those who rejected the Imams and Prophets. The keepers' question serves as a rhetorical confirmation of accountability, emphasizing that the warning was clear and the opportunity for repentance was fully available to the disbelievers.
